notes.title: Grave Deceiver
notes.notes:
Acknowledgement & Feedback:
We have read your feedback and thank all players for their input!
Issues raised include:
An over-reliance on specific buffs (such as volley and attack speed) to survive.
Difficulties in building viable setups due to a lack of variety and usefulness in buffs.
Unbalanced boss encounters, with the final boss being particularly punishing.
A random perk system that makes it challenging to obtain the essential upgrades.
The absence of in-game music or soundtracks, which affects the overall atmosphere.
What’s New in This Update:
Upgrade Card Reroll: You can now reroll the randomly offered upgrade cards if you’re not satisfied with the initial option.
Bullet Blocking: Summons and projectiles now block enemy bullets.
Enemy Rebalance: Adjusted enemy damage and health to provide a fairer challenge, especially during large waves.
Wave Control Improvements: Enhanced control over enemy waves for a more dynamic and balanced gameplay experience.

notes.title: Big Update – “Lightning Rain” Has Arrived!
notes.notes:
We’re thrilled to introduce a major update featuring our brand-new upgrade, “Lightning Rain”, the star of this patch! In English, it’s called “Storm.” This upgrade unleashes powerful lightning strikes, adding a dramatic flair to your battles.

We’ve also renamed several existing upgrades in English to be shorter and more intuitive:

Haste → Swift
Hemorrhage → Wound
Reaper → Scatter
Grave → Large
Wraith → Velocity
Tomb → Might
Phantom → Bounce
Shard → Fragment
Mend → Heal
Rise → Lift
Drain → Siphon
Specter → Fleet
Luck → Crit
Pallor → Shield
Restore → Cure
(Upgrades Volley, Swarm, and Vital kept their English names.)

We hope you enjoy the clearer names and the thrilling new “Lightning Rain” upgrade. Thanks for playing and for your continued support!
